apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
apps.versionDescription:
Nuvio 0.5.5 | nuvio-0.5.5-full-release

- [feat(i18n): add Bengali (বাংলা) language support and UI localization (#2113)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2113) @TanvirSdq  
- [i18n(el): sync Greek translations and remove remaining English loanwords (#2132)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2132) @nosvasedis  
- [Landscape clearlogo toggle, Simkl type hint, TMDB source priority, folder TMDB ID resolution (#2084)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2084) @skoruppa  
- [fix(UI): Fix hero section sometimes shifting (#2128)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2128) @ThEgIGN  
- [fix(player): show the swipe-to-seek preview in the new player layout (#2122)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2122) @deejay189393  
- 6aa42153 fix(debrid): select requested episode files @tapframe  
- [i18n(vi): update latest Vietnamese strings (#2096)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2096) @blueocean2308  
- [Translation improvements and adjustments for Slovak language (#2104)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2104) @mmsw91  
- [fix(mdblist): show newest library additions first (#2103)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2103) @halibiram
